definition: Fraction of called phased haplotypes exactly matching the AgamP4 reference across the complete 20-nt protospacer + 3-nt PAM.
Fraction of called phased haplotypes matching reference across the 3 PAM bases.
Fraction matching reference across the 20 protospacer bases.
Largest alternate-allele frequency among SNPs falling in the 23-bp target, evaluated across primary country-taxon populations.
Mean 2p(1-p) per base across the 23-bp target, with invariant positions contributing zero; this is a heterozygosity proxy, not classical nucleotide diversity pi.
10th percentile of country-taxon population exact-match fractions.
Fraction of assessed country-taxon populations with at least 95% exact target match.
Prespecified score for a 2- or 3-site portfolio based on global and population lower-tail probability that at least one target remains intact.
Weighted combination of the best single-site, pair and triple robustness scores (55%, 30%, 15%, renormalized if a component is unavailable).
